capabilities.name: Open Desk
capabilities.purpose: Open the Workbench surface and its current workspace.
capabilities.status_reason: The root route and DeskApp are present in source; /desk is an alias redirect and this documentation lane did not establish owner observation.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Browser route enters the Desk shell; no native host is required.
capabilities.egress: Opening the Desk does not itself send data off device.
capabilities.authority: The route registry admits the Desk shell.

sources.claim: / is registered as the primary Desk route.
/desk and unknown paths redirect to /.
DeskApp composes the Workbench shell.

tests.node: routes a registered surface and reports unregistered ones
tests.assertion: The tested dispatcher renders the registered surface path and reports an unregistered surface.

limitations: No owner observation recorded in this lane.

capabilities.name: Arrange windows
capabilities.purpose: Move, resize, snap, minimize, maximize and restore Desk windows.
capabilities.status_reason: Window frame, geometry algorithms and focused assertions are present; run and owner observation remain outside this lane.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Pointer and keyboard events remain in the browser Desk frame and update local store state.
capabilities.authority: The focused window and geometry reducer admit arrangement changes.

sources.claim: Window rectangles are clamped to the work band and minimum dimensions.
The shared frame owns geometry and focus callbacks.

tests.node: four windows tile 2x2 inside the working band, no overlap
tests.assertion: Expose layout assertions verify bounded non-overlapping rectangles.

tests.node: minimize parks the window (mounted but hidden) and the dock restores it
tests.assertion: The lifecycle test asserts park and restore behavior.

limitations: One browser viewport; no native multi-display geometry.

capabilities.name: Inspect Desk object
capabilities.purpose: Open a selected object in a named window surface with identity, state, provenance and verbs.
capabilities.status_reason: The surface contract and shared components exist, but object/projection parity and provenance coverage are incomplete.
capabilities.trust_boundary: A Desk object id selects a browser surface; backend data enters through the API/runtime seams.
capabilities.egress: A surface may display runtime-backed data and an explicit egress chip; inspection alone does not send data.
capabilities.authority: The selected object and registered surface determine the inspection scope.

sources.claim: The shared surface grammar requires identity, state, provenance and verbs.
The library exports the supported surface components from one path.

tests.node: routes a registered surface and reports unregistered ones
tests.assertion: Surface dispatch distinguishes a registered surface from an unregistered one.

tests.node: declares properties only where a real update path backs them
tests.assertion: The inspected suite asserts information contract fields.

limitations: Some windows have no provenance receipt.

capabilities.name: Run a Desk verb
capabilities.purpose: Offer and run a named operation for the current Desk context.
capabilities.status_reason: Registry availability, ghost reasons and local runners are implemented; async receipts and several backend runners remain incomplete.
persistence: workspace state when a verb changes it
capabilities.trust_boundary: A user gesture enters the registry; only a registered available runner can mutate state or call a backend.
capabilities.egress: Backend verbs may egress according to their API and egress receipt; local verbs do not.
capabilities.authority: Verb availability and current context are the admission checks.

sources.claim: Definitions include ids, labels, availability and runner behavior.
The registry enumerates Desk verbs.

tests.node: object verbs ghost WITH a reason when nothing is selected
tests.assertion: A missing selection yields a reasoned ghost verb.

tests.node: a ghosted verb refuses quietly (⌘W with no window open)
tests.assertion: The keymap does not run a ghosted verb.

limitations: Thread registry runners are metadata-only; ThreadComposer and its pullout callbacks own execution.

capabilities.name: Drop Desk object or file
capabilities.purpose: Apply a named internal or external drop effect only when the source and target contract allows it.
capabilities.status_reason: The internal matrix and glass file-drop seam are present and tested; keyboard equivalents, multi-select and full importer receipts remain gaps.
persistence: domain effect persistence when importer accepts
network_requirements: none for classification; importer may call API
capabilities.trust_boundary: Browser drag payload is classified by a local matrix before an importer or domain effect is invoked.
capabilities.egress: An importer may send the accepted file/content to a backend; the matrix itself does not.
capabilities.authority: Only explicit DROP_MATRIX rules and registered release targets admit a drop.

sources.claim: The matrix enumerates supported kind pairs and named effects.
External files are accepted only over a release target.

tests.node: unlisted pairs refuse (inert, never a guess)
tests.assertion: Unlisted source/target pairs return no effect.

tests.node: every hub-supported suffix imports; junk refuses by name
tests.assertion: The inspected suite asserts external dragover/drop handling.

limitations: No keyboard equivalent for every effect.

capabilities.name: Persist workspace
capabilities.purpose: Restore and save the local Desk arrangement with a bounded versioned shape.
capabilities.status_reason: The v1 storage key, shape, caps and corrupt-data fallback are implemented and assertion-tested; owner observation is not established.
capabilities.trust_boundary: The browser's localStorage boundary holds arrangement metadata; domain records remain outside this workspace slot.
capabilities.egress: Workspace layout is not sent to a network destination by this module.
capabilities.authority: The current Desk store owns writes; invalid external storage is rejected.

sources.claim: The key is hs.desk.workspace.v1.
Wrong version, invalid JSON and invalid shape return an empty workspace.

tests.node: round-trips rects + order + max through one slot; min stays out (HS-97-03)
tests.assertion: The persistence test asserts the v1 record fields and excludes minimum dimensions.

limitations: Write failure is not a user receipt.

capabilities.name: Reflect runtime state
capabilities.purpose: Keep Desk surfaces truthful while the single runtime bus connects, reconnects or is offline.
capabilities.status_reason: RuntimeBus has bounded reconnect states and malformed-frame handling; domain surface reconciliation is not universal.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Network frames cross into a guarded browser bus; malformed frames are ignored before consumers receive state.
capabilities.egress: The bus receives runtime data; downstream operations may egress according to their own API contracts.
capabilities.authority: The bus owns transport state; domain consumers own refetch and mutation authority.

sources.claim: RuntimeBus owns the socket, states, ping and bounded reconnect policy.
ApiError preserves status and payload message.

tests.node: owns one socket and removes it with the provider
tests.assertion: The inspected test asserts one socket, protocol, token omission and provider cleanup.

tests.node: turns a server detail into a user-readable typed error
tests.assertion: The API test asserts status and message survive a non-2xx response.

capabilities.name: Native Desk host seam
capabilities.purpose: Provide bounded display, filesystem and host integration capabilities when a native adapter is later adopted.
capabilities.status_reason: The desktop ADR defines a proposed seam; no Electron, Tauri or other native host is installed or declared.
capabilities.trust_boundary: A future native adapter is a separate authority boundary; the browser surface must receive only typed, permitted results.
capabilities.egress: Host file/process/network capabilities could egress; each capability must declare its boundary and receipt.
capabilities.authority: Future host permission and adapter allowlist; no current implementation authority.

sources.claim: The parent-owned ADR proposes a bounded native seam.

components.name: Desk shell
components.purpose: Compose route, world, list, windows and chrome.

sources.claim: DeskApp mounts the Desk composition.

components.name: World projection
components.purpose: Project primitive records into Pixi world objects and list objects.

sources.claim: World descriptors contain stable object fields and placement.

components.name: Window system
components.purpose: Manage frame chrome, focus, geometry, lifecycle and Dock/Expose views.

sources.claim: The shared frame owns window interactions.

components.name: Desk verb registry
components.purpose: Define availability, labels, shortcuts and runners in one registry.

sources.claim: The registry enumerates Desk verbs.

components.name: Surface library
components.purpose: Render portable object surfaces, patterns and gadgets.

sources.claim: The barrel is the supported import path for surface components.

components.name: Runtime bus
components.purpose: Reflect WebSocket and API runtime health to consumers.

sources.claim: RuntimeBus owns one guarded runtime socket and connection state.

integrations.name: Desk to HTTP API
integrations.purpose: Fetch and mutate domain records from Desk surfaces.

sources.claim: The API helper issues requests and maps non-2xx responses to ApiError.

integrations.auth: web auth token/cookie through existing auth seam
secrets: auth token handled by auth module
integrations.authority: API routes remain authoritative for persisted domain state.
integrations.failure: ApiError with status/message; surface retry or recovery is caller-owned.

tests.node: turns a server detail into a user-readable typed error
tests.assertion: See matching capability row and inspected test assertion.

integrations.name: Desk to RuntimeBus
integrations.purpose: Receive runtime events and connection health.

sources.claim: The bus owns WebSocket connection state and event delivery.

secrets: runtime auth handled outside Desk surface
integrations.authority: RuntimeBus owns transport truth; Desk consumers own domain reconciliation.
integrations.failure: bounded reconnect, offline state, malformed frames ignored

tests.node: owns one socket and removes it with the provider
tests.assertion: See matching capability row and inspected test assertion.

integrations.name: Desk to browser localStorage

sources.claim: Workspace arrangement uses the versioned localStorage key.

integrations.authority: Desk store owns the arrangement; localStorage is storage only.
integrations.failure: wrong version/corrupt input returns defaults; write failures are not surfaced uniformly

tests.node: round-trips rects + order + max through one slot; min stays out (HS-97-03)
tests.assertion: See matching capability row and inspected test assertion.

integrations.name: Desk to future DesktopHost
integrations.purpose: Provide bounded native display/filesystem capabilities when adopted.

sources.claim: The ADR defines a proposed host seam.

integrations.authority: Future host grants only declared capabilities; current browser path has no host authority.

domain_model.name: World object
domain_model.purpose: Stable primitive projected into a spatial/list Desk view.

sources.claim: World objects carry id, kind, label, subtitle, position and visual fields.

domain_model.storage: derived from primitive records; arrangement metadata in workspace storage
domain_model.lifecycle: derive, select, inspect, mutate through named verb, refresh

domain_model.name: Window state
domain_model.purpose: Local frame geometry and lifecycle state for an open Desk surface.

sources.claim: Persisted workspace includes panel rect, window rect/order/max, zones and preferences.

domain_model.lifecycle: open, focus, move/resize, park/maximize, restore, close

domain_model.name: Desk verb
domain_model.purpose: Named user operation with scope, availability and runner.

sources.claim: Verb definitions encode id, label, scope, availability and runner.

domain_model.storage: source registry; outcomes are not uniformly persisted
domain_model.lifecycle: registered, available/ghost, invoked, pending/completed/failed where runner supports it

domain_model.name: Operation receipt
domain_model.purpose: Durable explanation of accepted, running, completed or failed work.

sources.claim: Receipt renders status, label and timestamp fields.

domain_model.lifecycle: accepted, running, succeeded, failed, retried, parked

trust_boundaries.name: Browser Desk to HTTP API
trust_boundaries.purpose: Bound domain requests and responses at the HTTP seam.

sources.claim: The API helper is the browser HTTP boundary.

trust_boundaries.compute: API server validates and executes domain operation.
secrets: Auth token/cookie stays in existing auth seam
trust_boundaries.audit: API error and operation logging; Desk receipt integration is incomplete.

trust_boundaries.name: Browser Desk to runtime bus
trust_boundaries.purpose: Guard WebSocket events and connection state before Desk consumption.

sources.claim: Malformed frames are ignored and reconnect is bounded.

trust_boundaries.compute: RuntimeBus validates frame shape and manages reconnect timers.
secrets: Runtime auth is outside surface components
trust_boundaries.audit: Connection states are observable; consumer refetch audit is incomplete.

trust_boundaries.name: Desk browser to local workspace
trust_boundaries.purpose: Keep arrangement metadata in the browser origin boundary.

sources.claim: Invalid records are rejected and replaced by defaults.

trust_boundaries.compute: Storage helper serializes and validates bounded shape.
secrets: No domain secrets are intended in workspace storage
trust_boundaries.audit: Corrupt-data fallback is tested; write failure telemetry is incomplete.

trust_boundaries.name: Browser Desk to future native host
trust_boundaries.purpose: Keep native capability authority behind a typed adapter.

sources.claim: The ADR proposes a bounded host interface.

trust_boundaries.compute: Host performs only allowlisted capability work.
trust_boundaries.authority: Future host permissions and adapter policy
trust_boundaries.audit: Not implemented; no adapter tests or audit events exist.
